app.name: AnantaOne
app.pulse: Bangladesh pulse — shops, stock, and delivery in one flow

shop.catalogHint: Fresh stock from this producer. Order online for delivery.
shop.outsideDeliveryNote: Outside covered wards — zone charge applies
shop.orderPlacedHint: The shop will confirm and deliver. Keep your invoice code.

home.emptyBuyers: No shops yet — run seed or add a buyer.

owner.readOnlyHint: Employees can view products but not edit them.
owner.onlineOrdersHint: Orders from your public shop. Call the customer to confirm qty, then open Sell — or quick-accept with FEFO batches.
owner.onlineSellLoaded: Online order loaded — call customer, adjust qty/price/batch, then confirm.
owner.onlineSellConfirmHint: Confirming here accepts the order, picks batches, stocks out, and credits cash.
owner.onlineSellNotPending: This online order is no longer pending.
owner.deliveryHint: Set your company location first. Seed wards for your upazila, mark nearest as free, set outside/zila charges, and category rates. Coupons discount merchandise subtotal.
owner.wardsHint: Toggle free delivery for nearest wards. If not in a ward: same-upazila outside wards → same zila other upazila → other zila (one charge only).
owner.setupDeliveryAreas: Auto-create delivery wards for this upazila
owner.locationDeliveryHint: Saving location with auto-setup creates Ward 1…N for free/local delivery. Set outside & zila charges under Delivery.
owner.deliveryZoneHint: Only one charge applies — never stacked. Closest match wins.
owner.deliveryZoneSteps: How charging works: (0) Customer ward in your list → free or ward base charge. (1) Same upazila but not in your ward list → charge 1. (2) Same zila, different upazila → charge 2. (3) Different zila → charge 3. Outside-wards is NOT other-zila.
owner.outsideAreaChargeHint: Same upazila as your company, but ward not in your free/local list.
owner.sameDistrictChargeHint: Same district/zila as you, different upazila.
owner.otherDistrictChargeHint: Customer district/zila is different from yours.
owner.setCompanyLocationFirst: Set company division → district → upazila on the Company page first.
owner.categoryRatesHint: Charged per unit qty when the ward is not free (e.g. drinking water by bottle weight).
owner.couponsHint: Discount applies to product subtotal before delivery.
owner.siteHint: Upload logo, hero media, and product images to Cloudinary. Customize colors and fonts — each company gets its own look.
owner.cloudinaryMissing: Cloudinary is not configured on the API. Set CLOUDINARY_URL on Render, then redeploy.
owner.uploadSectionHint: Choose a file below. Logo and hero appear on your public shop. A new upload replaces only that slot — even if logo and hero currently share the same picture.
owner.uploadLogoHint: PNG or JPG — shown in the public shop hero and header.
owner.uploadHeroHint: Wide photo for the top of your public shop.
owner.uploadVideoHint: MP4 or WebM — plays behind the shop headline.
owner.productImageHint: Optional. Photo is compressed and uploaded when you save the product.
owner.sharedBrandingHint: Logo and hero can share one file. Use Remove on a slot to clear only that slot — the file stays in the library so you can replace either one with a new upload.
owner.deleteMediaConfirm: Delete this file from the library?
owner.deleteMediaConfirmInUse: This file is used as {slot}. Delete removes it from that slot too. Continue?
owner.deleteMediaConfirmShared: This file is used for more than one slot (for example logo and hero). Delete removes it from all of them. To clear only one slot, use Remove on that slot above. Continue deleting the file?
owner.mediaLibraryHint: Files are stored under anantaone/tenants/{your-slug}/… on Cloudinary.
owner.mediaEmpty: No uploads yet — use the file pickers above.
owner.companyHint: Update how AnantaOne appears to your team and shops.
owner.productsHint: Pick a preset or custom SKU. Set size, unit, price in BDT, and stock.
owner.deactivateBuyerHint: Deactivate {name}? They will no longer appear in active buyer lists.
owner.buyersHint: Register B2B buyer shops, contacts, and wards for this company.
owner.staffHint: Register and edit staff — salary, joining date, branch, and profile photo. Owners control accounts.
owner.staffDenied: Only owners and managers can view staff.
owner.staffOwnerOnly: Only the owner can register, edit, or deactivate staff.
owner.staffPhotoHint: Optional. Shown in the staff table and can be changed later.
owner.passwordKeepHint: Leave blank to keep current password
owner.passwordNewHint: Set a password for this staff login
owner.numberOptionalHint: Optional — leave blank to save empty
owner.deactivateStaffHint: Deactivate {name}? They will no longer be able to sign in. You can keep their records for history.
owner.branchesHint: Create branches and assign a manager. Extra employees are optional.
owner.branchesDenied: Only owners and managers can view branches.
owner.branchesOwnerOnly: Only the owner can create or edit branches.
owner.branchesEmpty: No branches yet. Create the first branch for this company.
owner.noStaffToAssign: No other staff available — manager-only is fine, or register more staff first.
owner.branchLockedHint: You can only access your assigned branch
owner.employeeRequired: Select at least one employee for this branch
owner.branchAssignHint: Assign a branch manager. You can add employees now or later.
owner.branchEmployeesHint: Optional. The manager above is already on this branch — pick more people only if needed.
owner.branchWorkspaceHint: You only see orders and staff for your assigned branch. Product catalog and company analytics stay with the owner for now.
owner.productsOwnerOnly: Only the company owner can create, edit, or remove products for now.
owner.walletHint: Sales credit this drawer from the Sell tab. Record material buys, utility bills, and other expenses here — each one debits cash automatically.
owner.walletSaleNote: Every counter sale already credits this ledger. Use Sell to take orders:
owner.materialDebitHint: Bottles, acid, water, etc. by L or pcs. Add transport, driver, and travel so landed cost tells you what to charge shops.
owner.supplyNameHint: e.g. RO water / 500ml bottle / citric acid
owner.landedCostHint: Landed cost = (goods + transport + driver + travel) ÷ qty — use this when setting sell price.
owner.expenseDebitHint: Utility, transport, driver, travel, family, lawsuit, gesture, or other cash-out. Debits automatically.
owner.analyticsEmpty: No cost data in this period yet.
owner.expenseTitleHint: e.g. DESCO bill / driver trip / court fee
owner.paymentsHint: Pay manager/employee salary from the cash drawer (debit).
owner.paymentsOwnerOnly: Only the owner can pay salaries.
owner.salaryReverseHint: In an emergency you can reverse a salary payment with a reason — cash is credited back to the drawer.
owner.salaryReverseFormHint: This credits the cash drawer by the salary amount. Use only for mistakes or emergencies.
owner.salaryReverseReasonHint: e.g. Wrong amount / staff returned cash / emergency clawback
owner.salaryReverseDone: Salary reversed — cash credited to drawer.
owner.sellHint: Phone, online, or walk-in orders. Add one or many SKUs, allocate batch (FEFO), confirm — stock drops and cash drawer credits.
owner.sellNeedBatch: No batch with stock — create a production batch first
owner.sellBatchShort: Batch does not have enough remaining qty
owner.sellNeedLines: Add at least one product line
owner.printTagsHint: Print QR tags for these batches →
owner.batchesHint: Each production run gets a batch code, mfg/expiry, remaining qty, and optional unit QR tags. Counter sell pulls from FEFO batches.
owner.unitTagsEmpty: No unit tags for this batch.
owner.reverseBatchHint: Reverse batch {code}? Remaining stock is removed and unit tags are voided. Reason is required.
owner.batchReversed: Batch reversed — stock removed and tags voided.
owner.tagsHint: Customize tag size and fields (SKU, sell price, description, dates, QR). Tag text can be independent of catalog.
owner.tagFieldsHint: Choose what prints on the tag.
owner.tagDescHint: Optional text only for the sticker
owner.tagDateHint: Create/MFG date starts from when the product was added. You may move it forward only — not backward. Expiry is set when you print the tag.
owner.saveDatesToBatch: Also save these dates to the batch when confirming
owner.tagLiveHint: Tag updates live as you change dates, size, product, or batch.
owner.mfgForwardOnly: Create/MFG date cannot be before the product create date
owner.mfgForwardHint: Auto from product create — forward only
owner.expAtPrintHint: Decide expiry when printing this tag
owner.priceOverrideHint: Catalog price is the default. You can change sell price per line (e.g. ৳35 → ৳50). Invoice and cash drawer use the sold price; catalog stays unchanged.
owner.priceOverrideNote: Sell price differs from catalog list price for this sale.
owner.historyHint: All confirmed counter / phone / online sales. Open any row to reprint the invoice.
owner.selectOrder: Select a sale to view its invoice.
owner.invoiceQrHint: Scan this QR to find this invoice later.
owner.searchInvoiceHint: INV-20260717-XXXXXX or paste scanned QR URL
owner.reverseHint: Restores stock to batches and debits the cash drawer (opposite of the sale credit). Reason is required.
owner.reverseReasonHint: e.g. Wrong shop / damaged goods / customer returned
owner.reverseDone: Sale cancelled — stock restored and cash debited.
owner.cancelSaleHint: Restocks every line back to its batch and debits the cash drawer by the invoice total.

auth.loginHint: Owners, managers, employees, and SaaS super admin.
auth.registerHint: Creates your company and the first owner account.
